data.gender_notes: Ibnat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ibnat is an Arabic name for a daughter or girl. It is derived from the Arabic root 'ibn' meaning 'son', but with a prefix 'i' added to make it mean 'daughter' instead. The name Ibnat carries the meaning “Daughter, girl” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ibnat usually hope their child will grow to embody daughter, girl and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ibnat represents the feminine aspect of creation and the nurturing, caring nature of a mother. It is a name that evokes feelings of love, compassion, and protection.
data.etymology: Ibnat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Daughter, girl.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibnat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: ابنة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الابنة أو الأنثى
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، يعني الابنة أو الأنثى، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، مثل قوله تعالى: 'وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَتْ فَرْجَهَا' (آل عمران: 42)، ويشير إلى الأنثى الصالحة والمؤمنة.

in_urdu.name: ابنات
in_urdu.meaning: اسم معنی ہے بیٹی یا کنواری
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی मूल کا ایک نسائی نام ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بیٹی یا کنواری۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ آل عمران میں: 'وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَتْ فَرْجَهَا' (آل عمران: 42)। یہ نام مسلمانوں میں خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیاء میں مقبول ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इब्नत
in_hindi.meaning: इब्नत नाम का अर्थ है बेटी या कन्या
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है बेटी या कन्या। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है और अक्सर मुस्लिम समुदायों में प्रयोग किया जाता है। इस नाम का उल्लेख कुरआन में भी मिलता है।

in_pashto.name: ابنته
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا د یوه ښځینه نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستی شوی دی. ددی نوم معنی د ابنې یا نجلې ده. دا نوم په افغانستان او پاکستان کی د پښتنو په منځ کی ډیر مشهور دی.

in_english.name: Ibnat
in_english.long_meaning: Ibnat is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'daughter' or 'girl'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'b-n-t', which is also related to the word 'ibn', meaning 'son'. The name Ibnat has been used in Islamic tradition and is mentioned in the Quran. It signifies a pious and virtuous girl.

By prefixing the root 'ibn' with 'i', the name creates a new word signifying a daughter or female member of the family. This not only highlights the value placed on femininity and motherhood within the society but also emphasizes the role of women as essential carriers of family names and lineages.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islam, the name Ibnat can also hold spiritual significance as it reminds us of the role of women in nurturing and raising children as future generations, who will carry out their faith and contribute to the community. The name underscores the importance of women in the collective Islamic identity and upholding Islamic values. It fosters a sense of responsibility and purpose for maintaining family ties and preserving spiritual knowledge from one generation to the next.
